archetype: 5 (Luxury / Cinematic) mixed with warm storybook elements

rules.anti_pattern: Strictly no Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif fonts anywhere.
rules.dialogue: Leading relaxed (1.6+), minimum size text-lg for readability.

layout_and_spacing.container: 16:9 cinematic aspect ratio centered on screen, maximum height 90vh.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for dialogue boxes and UI panels. Avoid cramming elements.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Interactive panels must feature 1px solid or patterned borders (use the provided ornate border asset) to separate from the dark background.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: UI text centered, dialogue text left-aligned with character portrait on the left.

main_menu.layout: Full-screen background image (main_menu_bg) with an ornate vertical list of menu buttons centered or left-aligned.

scene_viewport.layout: Holds the scene backgrounds (scene_fantasy/scene_reality) and layered hotspots. Must manage state of the toggle.

scumm_verb_panel.layout: Grid layout (grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-3) of verb buttons (Look, Use, Talk, Take, Combine) housed in a parchment-styled container.

inventory_bar.layout: Flexbox row or grid of dark square slots with subtle gold borders. Placed near the verb panel.

renpy_dialogue_box.layout: Fixed bottom panel spanning 80-90% width. Flex layout with a character portrait (left/right) and dialogue text area. Use the ui_parchment texture as background.

fantasy_reality_toggle.layout: Absolute positioned elegant button (top-right of viewport). Changes state between fantasy (purple/gold) and reality (sepia).

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Smooth 0.5s crossfade between fantasy and reality views.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons elevate (-translate-y-1) and gain a soft #FFB042 drop-shadow.
motion_and_interactions.cursor: Apply the cursor_paw asset as the default cursor globally, and add an active state for hotspots.

main_menu_bg.description: Hero background for the main title screen.

scene_reality.description: Background for the mundane reality viewpoint.

portrait_fluffy_fantasy.description: Character portrait for the dialogue box when in fantasy mode.

portrait_fluffy_reality.description: Character portrait for the dialogue box when in reality mode.

ui_parchment.description: Seamless texture to be used as background for dialogue boxes, journals, and UI panels.

ui_border.description: Ornate Victorian frame element to decorate UI panels or portraits.

cursor_paw.description: Custom mouse cursor for the game.

instructions_to_main_agent: Must use ONLY the image URLs provided in the assets section. No placeholder services.
Implement data-testid attributes on ALL interactive UI elements (e.g., data-testid='start-game-btn', data-testid='fantasy-toggle').
Load 'IM Fell English', 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Crimson Text', and 'Pirata One' via Google Fonts. DO NOT use generic UI fonts like Inter.
Ensure UI components (SCUMM verbs, Dialogue Box) visually layer over the 16:9 scene viewport without hiding critical scene info.
Do not use generic Shadcn/Tailwind default styles for the core game UI. Override them to match the dark fantasy storybook aesthetic.
Use the ui_parchment image as a repeating background (or cover) for panels with text_ink as the font color for readability.
Use lucide-react or specific SVG icons only for minor UI elements (Settings, Sound), otherwise rely on styled text and borders.
